in_arabic.name: إكرامة
in_arabic.meaning: إكرامة تعني التكريم والإجلال والاحترام في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: إكرامة هو اسم مشتق من كلمة كرم، ويعني التكريم والإجلال والاحترام. في اللغة العربية، الكرم هو السخاء والجود، ومن هنا يأتي معنى إكرامة كونه تعبيرًا عن التقدير والاحترام العاليين. وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن كرامة الإنسان ورفع شأنه

in_urdu.name: اکرامہ
in_urdu.meaning: اکرامہ کا مطلب ہے احترام، تکریم اور عزت کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اکرامہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے احترام، تکریم اور عزت کرنا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'کرم' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سخاوت اور عطا کرنا۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یہ نام ان اعلیٰ صفات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جن کی تعریف قرآن میں کی گئی ہے، جیسے سخاوت، عطا کرنے اور احترام کرنا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، اکرامہ ایک مقبول نام ہے جو اچھے اخلاق اور کردار کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इकरामाह
in_hindi.meaning: इकरामाह का अर्थ है सम्मान, आदर और इज़्ज़त करना
in_hindi.long_meaning: इकरामाह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सम्मान, आदर और इज़्ज़त करना। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'करम' क्रिया से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है उदारता और दान करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम उन उच्च गुणों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जिनका वर्णन कुरआन में किया गया है, जैसे उदारता, दान करना और सम्मान करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इकरामाह एक लोकप्रिय नाम है जो अच्छे चरित्र और नैतिकता के महत्व को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: إکرامہ
in_pashto.meaning: د إکرامہ مطلب دے د احترام، تکریم او عزت کولو
in_pashto.long_meaning: إکرامہ د عربي نوم دی چی دے مطلب يې احترام، تکریم او عزت کولو. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'کرم' کلمې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چي د سخاوت او ورکړې معنی لري. د افغان او پښتن مسلمانو په دود، دا نوم د هغو لوړو ځانګړتیاوو استازیتوب کوي چي په قرآن کې يې تعریف کړی دی، لکه سخاوت، ورکړې او احترام. په پښتو کلتور کې، إکرامہ يو مشهور نوم دی چي د ښو اخلاقو او کردار اهميت ښيي

in_english.name: Ikramah
in_english.meaning: Ikramah means honor, respect, and generosity in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Ikramah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'karama', meaning honor, respect, and generosity. In Islamic tradition, this name represents the virtues of kindness, charity, and esteem, as mentioned in the Quran. Historically, Ikramah has been used to signify the importance of good character and moral values. Across Muslim cultures, Ikramah is a popular name that embodies the spirit of hospitality, respect, and compassion

data.cultural_impact: The name Ikramah holds deep cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is derived from the Arabic word "ikramah," which means kindness, generosity, and compassion. In Islamic culture, the virtue of kindness is highly valued and encouraged. Ikramah is not just a name, but a reminder of this essential quality that Muslims should cultivate in their daily lives. The person named Ikramah acts as a role model, exemplifying the true essence of Islam, which calls for treating others with kindness, respect, and generosity.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Ikramah also holds great spiritual significance, reflecting the moral and ethical values that Muslims are called to uphold. In Islamic teachings, being kind, compassionate, and generous is considered a path to achieving nearness to Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Give charity without delay, for it keeps away calamity." (Bukhari and Muslim). By embodying the qualities of kindness, generosity, and compassion, a person named Ikramah is not only fulfilling the cultural expectations of being a good Muslim but also striving towards spiritual growth and closeness to Allah. The name serves as a constant reminder that being kind, to both the believers and the disbelievers, is a part of living a God-conscious life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidayah Wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 4, Page 174-175 The name Ikramah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Battle of Hunayn - Muhammad's forces defeated the Hawazin and Thamud tribes, taking many prisoners. Ikramah bin Abul-Ju'd was the commander of the Hawazin forces, and when he surrendered, Muhammad treated him kindly and released him with his own personal guarantee.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hisham, Sirat Rasul Allah, Volume 1, Page 237 The name Ikramah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Battle of Hudaybiyyah - A peace treaty was signed between Muhammad and the Meccan tribes. Ikramah bin Abu Jahl was a prominent Meccan leader who refused to sign the treaty and led the opposition against it. However, after witnessing the defeat of the Meccan forces in the battle, he embraced Islam and became a prominent companion of Muhammad.

modern_usage.modern_context: Ikramah, an Arabic name meaning 'generosity, kindness, and mercy', has gained popularity in modern contexts as a reminder to spread positivity and kindness to oneself and others. It is often used as a hashtag (#Ikramah) on social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Reddit to encourage self-love, mental health awareness, and serving as an inspiration to others. Users share stories of acts of kindness, self-care routines, and uplifting messages to spread the message of Ikramah and promote a more compassionate and empathetic digital community.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Ikramah in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Ikramah, which means "generosity". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "generosity" symbolizes a person who is generous, kind, and compassionate. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ikramah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of generosity.
